name: Kimi no Nisemono ni Koi o Suru
original_name: キミのニセモノに恋をする
source: In the midst of the snowy season, a young salaryman meets a doppelganger of his ex girlfriend who broke his heart by disappearing without a word a year earlier.
translation: In the midst of the snowy season, a young salaryman meets a doppelganger of his ex girlfriend who broke his heart by disappearing without a word a year earlier.
